Senegal's announced squad excludes the previously forecast Boulaye Dia. Current team coverage identifies Sadio Mane as the player to watch and says the captain and all-time leading scorer is likely to lead the line, moving him ahead of Sarr and Jackson for the opener against France.

The squad makes the eligible set nearly closed: Mane scored in 2018; Sarr, Dieng and Koulibaly scored in 2022; the previously forecast Dia is absent, while Jackson and Ndiaye have no prior World Cup goal. Mane is likely to lead the line and Sarr is the strongest alternative.
